notes.title: Hello everyone before I start I apologize for my disappearance.
notes.content:
Hello everyone before I start I apologize for my disappearance.

I saw that many of you are waiting for the project.

Reason:

In 2018 I needed money, so I started my web development and communication company, so I work for companies since 2018 and I opened a second company in 2019, it took me a lot of time and work which prevented me from continuing my project.

Then I took the taste of my new life and the taste of travel which allowed me to go 1 month each year on vacation in the Caribbean.

Since January 2020 I have flashbacks on my phone (snap) of the development of Battle Army and it creates me a lot of pain not to have continued ...

Now I have my own office, where I can work, before I work in my room (not obvious).

This project I have been working on since I was 17 so it is very close to my heart.

Developing an fps with such high quality graphics was a real challenge, I could not continue without having more money.


It may be a new start for Battle Army, I started to develop a prototype (the source is very old and requires a lot of work to adapt it to our prerequisites today)


* What is certain is that during my absence I still did not learn to write  correctly

DISCORD : https://discord.gg/VGN563u

Cordial
Thomas

notes.title: BATTLE ARMY PAID FOR THE RELEASE
notes.content:
FOR GOOD CAUSE

Any self-respecting programmer knows how to get a game out is part of the fighter's course.

Especially when it is necessary to make it known to the greatest number of people.

Battle Army, an excellent and freshly available FPS on the Steam platform, is no exception to the rule, going from free to paid.

EXPLICATIONS

SOUCI D'API

There are pitfalls in any project, no matter how ambitious, that cannot be circumvented. The only solution: bouncing back to succeed. Free to begin with, Battle Army must inexorably pass to the payee to continue its way. Thus, following some problems encountered related to the Steam micro-transactions api, it will be necessary to pay a few euros to be able to fully enjoy the game. The price has not yet been set by Manda Games, which should not be long. It should also be noted that the idea of free-to-play is not totally abandoned, but simply discarded to take full advantage of Battle Army.

BATTLE ARMY IN TWO VERSIONS

In order not to penalize the most modest players financially, Manda Games had the judicious idea to release two versions of Battle Army. A demo version will be available for free. Here, players will have access to the online game on three maps and a TDM game mode. They will also have the opportunity to customize 

PROCESSUS

We will first release the paid version of the game, once it is finished the demo version will appear on Steam.

FREE TO PLAY A RETURN POSSIBLE

A return to free To play will be possible later in the development, it takes a lot of time and resources to develop.
